 ORDER

This Writ Petition has been filed challenging the order passed by the second respondent dated 04.06.2020 in proceedings in Award No. 6/2015 Na.Ka.J3/02/2010 and for directing the fourth respondent to inspect the building at S.No.562/15 at Thiruvanthancode Village, Kanyakumari District and fix correct valuation as per law.

3.The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the Competent Authority had determined the compensation for the building on the basis that the built-up area of the building was 1300 sq.ft.
This determination of the built-up area was challenged by the petitioner right through.
According to the petitioner, it is more than 2000 sq.ft.

The Competent Authority had passed the Award and the same was put to challenge before the District Collector/Arbitrator https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 and based on the determination of compensation, the compensation amount was also paid to the petitioner.
4.

Only issue that has been raised in the present Writ Petition is that the compensation for building was fixed by taking the built-up area as 1300 sq.ft. and whereas, it is now clear from the communication made by the second respondent that it is 2225 sq.ft.
It is stated that the compensation was paid for the building by determining the built-up area as 2225 sq.ft.
What is available on record is that the determination of compensation was only for built-up area of 1300 sq.ft.
Hence, the present Writ Petition confines itself only to this discrepancy in the builtup area and for payment of compensation for the remaining sq.ft.
5.The learned Special Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the first, second & fourth respondents sought for some time to get instructions.

The learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the third respondent National Highways Authority of India also sought for some time to get instructions and provide all particulars in this regard before this Court.

6. Post this Writ Petition under the caption Part Heard Cases on 09.11.2023.
3.When the matter was taken up for hearing today, the learned Standing Counsel appearing for the third respondent produced the details regarding the acquisition and the compensation paid to the petitioner and for proper appreciation, the same is extracted hereunder:

Hence, this Writ Petition is disposed of accordingly.
